description_en: Queries the server certificate of a TCP/SSL listener
description_zh: 查询TCPSSL监听的服务器证书
kebab_example: aliyun nlb list-listener-certificates --listener-id lsn-j49ht1jxxqyg450000@80 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListenerCertificates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener. Specify the ID of a listener that uses SSL over TCP
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

Ca: CA certificate.
Server: server certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

Ca：CA证书。
Server：服务器证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The server certificate. Only one server certificate is supported.

This parameter takes effect only for TCP/SSL listeners
parameters.help_zh:
服务器证书列表信息。目前仅支持添加 1 个服务器证书。

仅对 TCPSSL 监听生效
parameters.name: certificate_ids

schema.description_en: Queries the certificates of a TCP/SSL listener

CertificateId.description_en: The ID of the certificate. Only one server certificate is supported
CertificateId.description_zh: 证书ID，当前仅支持服务器证书

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is the default certificate of the listener. Valid values:

true
false
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为监听默认证书。取值：

true：默认证书。

false：扩展证书

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is associated with the listener. Valid values:

Associating
Associated
Diassociating
Status.description_zh:
证书与监听关联的状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。

Associated：已关联。

Diassociating：解除关联中
Status.title_en: 证书与监听关联的状态
Status.title_zh: 证书与监听关联的状态

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50，默认值为20

NextToken.description_en:
The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
